name: Doom
use_when: Use when every risk should bring the end closer and the table should feel it coming (slasher, a dying ship, a last night).

disasters: someone is taken: the danger reaches the most exposed character now
the way out is gone: a door seals, a bridge falls, the boat drifts off
the light fails: every lamp, torch and screen goes dark at once
a trusted thing turns: a friend, a tool, a safe room is not what it was
it finds the hiding place: everyone must move, now
the cost comes due: the worst wound or fear on the table gets worse
